name: Road to Empress Comments
tagline: Chinese Bilibili comments on Ludwig's Road to Empress, translated side by side
summary: I built it by adapting a Bilibili comment translator into its own site for Ludwig's motorcycle trip across China: thousands of comments and danmaku from Chinese viewers, shown next to English translations with notes on the slang, memes and cultural references.

name: LockIN
tagline: A Chrome extension that simulates tasing when you lock out
summary: Stay on a blacklisted site too long and it redirects you to a taser sound.

name: Reddit Meme Crawler
tagline: Scrapes Reddit images to be used as slander photos
summary: A Devvit app that grabs every image in a Reddit post and its comments. It built the meme library the slander bot pulls from.

name: JJK Slander Bot
tagline: A Discord bot that slanders you based on the words you say
summary: Say a trigger word like "potential" and it grabs a scraped Reddit meme of that character, finds the face with a YOLOv8 anime detector, checks it with a ViT classifier, and pastes your profile picture over it.

name: MamboIfier
tagline: Re-sings any song with a couple of funny syllables
summary: Record a funny one or two syllable word, like "mambo", and it re-sings songs using only those syllables.

name: RitoPaint
tagline: Draw on League replays and the annotations move as your camera moves
summary: A transparent overlay that reads the camera pose from League's Replay API, so your arrows and circles stay pinned to the map as the camera pans.

name: LinkedInDestroyer
tagline: Fires hollow purple at AI slop LinkedIn posts
summary: A Chrome extension for LinkedIn. It charges up, fires at AI slop posts, and leaves a hole where they were.

name: Genshin Soundpact
tagline: A map of Genshin's music over the years
summary: Showcases special pieces of music, fun facts, and comparisons from every region, from Mondstadt to Nod-Krai.
